missionPremise: Operator ruling 2026-08-18, dispatched under OPS-16 amendment A-018: the statewide serving sweep renders as a panel in Command Center under the County Manifest subtab, and the County Manifest itself is stale and must be refreshed to current state. Command Center is a read and sandbox surface over spine data and a consumer of Smart Site, not a second product. The record being rendered is FROZEN at _catalog/parcel_fact_sheet_contract/serving-sweep.ts with its six binding invariants at CONTRACT_RULES.md; a change to any of them returns to the planner rather than being negotiated in a lane. Lane P-43 (SS-W5, hauska-engine) produces the sweep data and this lane renders it without waiting. The disagreement between the two instruments is the FINDING, and the console must surface it rather than average it away.
completionPredicate: On the County Manifest panel a stranger can (a) see when the manifest was materialized and re-read it on demand, with the console saying plainly whether the re-read moved computedAt; (b) read which parts are derived from the API, which are hand-declared upstream, and which are presentation-only client lookups, from the console rather than from prose; (c) open a Serving sweep subtab rendering CountyServingSweep/StatewideServingSweep per the frozen type, with present / absentCovered / absentUncovered / unresolved as four separately measured classes carrying their denominator, unresolved styled as an outage and never folded into an absence; (d) see the rail reading and the served reading for the same county and field side by side with their gap in points, ranked worst first; (e) click an absence and get the underlying parcels. Suite green, PR open against main, not merged, not deployed. ALL MET.
scopeBasis: File ownership was apps/command-center/** only; five other lanes edit this repo in parallel. apps/property-explorer/** (P-39, P-40) and packages/map-renderer/** (P-41, P-42) were out of scope and nothing in them was touched — `git diff --name-only origin/main...HEAD | grep -v '^apps/command-center/'` returns 0 files. The recompute of county_facet_coverage lives in hauska-engine and the endpoint in cortex-api, both outside this repo, so 'refresh' here means a repeatable console-side RE-READ plus a derivation audit, never a recompute; the server-side items are routed to the planner below rather than attempted. Emitting sweep data is P-43 work.

howARefreshIsTriggeredAndByWhom.whatTheConsoleCanDo: RE-READ. A control on the County Manifest re-fetches GET /api/county-ledger through the same single read path the first load uses, then states whether computedAt moved. Anyone with the console open can do it.
howARefreshIsTriggeredAndByWhom.whatTheConsoleCannotDo: RECOMPUTE. Verified at source, not assumed: /api/county-ledger/recompute, /api/county-ledger/refresh and /api/serving-sweep all return HTTP 200 text/html 918 bytes through the console proxy, which is the documented cortex-api SPA fallthrough meaning the route does not exist. /api/county-ledger?refresh=1 returns the identical 2,121,656-byte materialized snapshot.
howARefreshIsTriggeredAndByWhom.whatActuallyMovesIt: county_facet_coverage is written as a side effect of engine block and scorer runs. On the live payload the writing instruments are named per cell: B2_cp2_geometry_scorer_apply.mjs (geometry), score_cad_rails_fast.mjs (cad, landuse, owner), countyFloodScoreCli.ts (flood), l16-score-mud.mjs (mud). zoning carries verificationMethod 'roster-load' with no lastVerifiedAt. So the refresh is triggered by whoever runs a block or scorer for a county, in hauska-engine — not by the console and not by the operator clicking anything.
howARefreshIsTriggeredAndByWhom.whyThisIsTheHonestDesign: A refresh button that re-renders the same snapshot is how a stale instrument passes for a live one. The control is labelled re-read, and a re-read that does not move computedAt is displayed as evidence of upstream staleness with the unchanged value and its age. It is repeatable, and repeating it is informative rather than cosmetic.
